title: Lithic platform tabs
description: A centred 32px headline over a big lavender card: copy with amethyst check bullets and a white pill on the left, a stack of three floating white panels in the middle, and a right-aligned list of tab names that steps through on its own. A small ring in the corner fills while each tab is shown, then the next tab fades in. On phones the tabs sit in a 2×2 grid on top.
notes: uses accent (lavender) for the card and accent-foreground (amethyst) for its ink
autoplay: each tab shows for `interval` ms, driven by the ring's CSS animation; a click jumps to a tab; no autoplay with reduced motion
the visual is a media slot per tab; empty, it is three white rounded placeholders the size of the original's floating panels
name: lithic-platform

props.name: interval
props.description: how long each tab shows before the next, in ms

props.name: tabsLabel
props.description: accessible name of the tab list
